description: Monitor a crypto price between agent runs and alert once when it crosses a threshold, with hysteresis before re-arming. Includes 7 days of polling. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (Base) — no API key, no account. Calling without payment returns 402 with the payment requirements. Free alternative: GET https://longwatch.dev/demo for a free NVDA Form 4 sample, or POST https://longwatch.dev/try for a 24h watch — no wallet needed.

above.description: price: USD upper threshold, e.g. 150000; provide above, below, or move_pct_24h

below.description: price: USD lower threshold, e.g. 90000; provide above, below, or move_pct_24h

idempotency_key.description: unique retry key; the same key and input return the original watch

move_pct_24h.description: price: absolute 24-hour percentage threshold, e.g. 5 for 5%

webhook.description: optional HTTPS endpoint for signed push alerts; polling still works

url.description: Public HTTPS webhook URL, e.g. https://example.com/alerts

name: watch_crypto_price
title: Watch a crypto price threshold
